title: Influencer & Community Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Influencer & Community Marketing Executive - Trade & DIY Sector

Location: Birmingham (Remote with travel)
Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 + Bonus
Hours: 8am-5pm (Flexible, but need to join a daily huddle daily at 8.15am)

Holidays: 24 days + statutory (4 days to be used during Christmas shutdown)

Are you the kind of person who naturally builds relationships wherever you go, and turns conversations into long-term partnerships?
Do you thrive in fast-paced, hands-on environments where you can get out on-site, create content, and grow a brand community from the ground up?

If this sounds like you, a fast-growing, innovative chemical manufacturer within the trade and DIY space is looking for an Influencer & Community Marketing Executive to help take their brand presence to the next level.

About the Company

This high-growth, entrepreneurial business has already built an impressive brand with millions of social impressions and strong national retail presence. With ambitious plans to scale significantly over the next few years, they're investing in building a loyal, authentic community of brand advocates across the trade and DIY market. You'll join a young, energetic team where collaboration, visibility, and a sense of humour are part of everyday life.

What's the role about?

This is a people-first, relationship-driven role where you'll become the face of the brand across the influencer and trade community. You'll:
- Build and grow a network of influencers, tradespeople and DIY creators
- Create and deliver engaging content alongside influencers and customers
- Represent the brand at trade events, on-site visits and networking opportunities
- Support sales activity by strengthening relationships with customers and partners
- Drive community engagement across social platforms and campaigns

Key Responsibilities
- Identify, recruit, and nurture relationships with influencers and brand ambassadors
- Manage influencer gifting, campaigns, and ongoing engagement
- Create and collaborate on high-performing social media content
- Visit sites, workshops, and merchant branches to capture authentic product use
- Organise influencer events, brand experiences, and trade show activity
- Grow online communities and encourage user-generated content and advocacy
- Track performance metrics including engagement, views, and influencer activity

Requirements

About You

You're someone who:
- Is naturally outgoing, confident, and thrives on building relationships
- Has experience working with influencers, communities, or brand advocates
- Understands (or has a genuine interest in) the trade, construction, or DIY sector
- Is hands-on with content creation and social media platforms
- Is highly organised and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Enjoys getting out into the field-meeting people, filming content, and representing a brand
- Thinks commercially and understands how marketing supports sales growth

Benefits

What's in it for you?
- Growth Opportunity - Join a business targeting significant expansion, with real progression potential
- Creative Freedom - Shape influencer strategy and content approach with autonomy
- Variety - A dynamic mix of field-based work, content creation, and relationship management
- Culture - Be part of a young, energetic, highly collaborative team
- Reward - Competitive salary, bonus after probation, and flexible working approach

title: Marketing & Client Services Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Client Services Coordinator

Location: Harborne, Birmingham

Basic Salary: £26,000 + Bonuses

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5:30pm

We're working with a growing independent estate agency looking for a Marketing & Client Services Coordinator to join their team.

This is a varied and exciting role combining property marketing, social media, content creation and client service.

The Role

You'll be involved in a wide range of activities, including:
- Preparing new properties for market, including property descriptions and floorplans
- Planning and creating social media content
- Writing blogs and local property content
- Coordinating direct-mail marketing campaigns
- Creating and repurposing video and property content
- Handling new enquiries and supporting existing clients
- Booking appointments and coordinating communication
- Bringing new ideas to improve the company's marketing and processes
- Managing multiple tasks, projects and deadlines

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Organized and highly detail-focused
- Confident communicating with people
- Creative with a good eye for engaging content
- Comfortable using technology and learning new systems
- Able to manage multiple priorities
- Proactive and full of ideas
- Keen to learn, develop and take ownership

Estate agency experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Full training will be provided on the property software, CRM, floorplans and internal processes.

Why Join?

This is a great opportunity to join an ambitious independent estate agency where you'll have the chance to make the role your own.

As the business grows, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and develop your career across marketing, client services and property.

The role is initially being recruited due to a maternity leave opening, with the potential for the right person to build a long-term career within the business.

Interested?

If you're organized, creative, confident and looking for a role where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager - Fixed Term Contract 2 Years
description:
Marketing Manager

Closing Date: 27th October 2026

Interview Date: 1st stage over Teams - 5th November 2026

2nd Interview Face to face - 12th November 2026

Band : Corporate Band E: £38,413 (year one), £39,908 (year two, subject to achieving objectives)

Team: Income Generation and Marketing Department

Hours: Full-time 37.5 hours per week, fixed term until December 2028 (covering a secondment)

DBS Required

Hybrid working with multi-site working from home and across both sites, Selly Park and Erdington

About the role

We are recruiting a Marketing Manager to support income growth through the delivery of Birmingham Hospice's income generation communications and marketing activity.

This is a two-year, fixed-term post covering a secondment - a genuine opportunity to make a lasting impact for a charity with ambitious plans for the future.

Leading a small team and working closely with income generation colleagues, you'll bring together fundraising, media, marketing, digital, creative and campaigns activity to maximise income, supporter acquisition and retention.

You'll be confident leading projects and working collaboratively across teams to deliver impactful campaigns through social media, email and paid media, bringing creativity, innovation and new ideas to help secure and grow all forms of voluntary income and raise the profile of Birmingham Hospice.

What you'll bring
- Some experience of line managing, mentoring or developing team members
- A background in a fundraising and/or communications environment
- A proven track record creating multimedia communications campaigns, including social media, email and paid digital advertising (e.g. Meta, Google, TikTok ads)
- Experience of developing and managing digiyal channels, including websites and a variety of social media platforms
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage a complex workload and prioritise effectively
- Creative thinking skills with the ability to spot opportunities for innovation and growth

What we offer
- Join a supportive, creative and collaborative team where your ideas are valued
- A varied and interesting role leading fundraising marketing, digital and campaigns activity
- Autonomy to try new things and bring innovation to your work
- Work that makes a genuine difference for people living with terminal illness and their families
- Recognition of prior NHS or hospice service (including pension and annual leave entitlements)
- Generous annual leave, wellbeing programmes and access to employee benefit platforms such as Stream and Engage

title: Paid Media Manager
description:
We're looking for a Paid Media Manager to take ownership of client acquisition strategy across Google Ads and paid social. You'll be the go-to expert for campaign strategy, execution and optimisation across Search, Display, Performance Max, Meta and LinkedIn.

What you'll be doing

You'll plan, manage and optimise paid media campaigns for a mix of B2 B clients across every major platform.

Build and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display and Performance Max

Plan and run paid social campaigns across Meta and LinkedIn, from audience strategy through to creative testing

Lead on strategy, execution and optimisation, with a clear focus on ROI and conversion metrics

Communicate campaign results and recommendations clearly to clients and internal stakeholders

Contribute to new business proposals and support the growth of our paid media offering

Keep on top of platform changes, emerging tools and performance trends across search and social

Set clear campaign goals and manage budgets to drive high-quality leads and conversions

Use audience signals, asset testing and structured reporting to get the most from PMax and paid social alike

Run structured A/B tests across creative, copy, audiences and targeting

What we're looking for

2+ years' experience managing paid media campaigns in an agency or performance marketing environment

Strong working knowledge of Search and Display campaign setup and structure

Hands-on experience with Performance Max e.g. asset groups, targeting, audience signals and optimisation

Practical experience running Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads for lead generation or ecommerce

Confidence with remarketing across both search and social

Comfortable working with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking tools

Strong communication skills - able to explain campaign performance clearly to clients

About JE Consulting

JE Consulting has been established for over 25 years, delivering exceptional marketing solutions to a wide range of B2 B, professional services, and SaaS software clients. As a full-service marketing agency, we either act as the dedicated marketing team for our clients or provide an extra layer of expertise to support their existing resources.

Why Join JE Consulting?

Work alongside a friendly and collaborative team

Flexibility to balance office and remote work hybrid

Opportunities for personal and professional development within a growing agency

Collaborate with a variety of B2 B and professional service clients, gaining broad industry experience.

JE Consulting is part of K3 Advisory Group
